sections.Profile:
"Toro" is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Rally Play Company in 1963. Designed for two players, it features four flippers and three pop bumpers.

- Manufacturer: Rally play Company
- Years made: 1963
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Original Theme, Bullfighting
